# YOKE AVR - Professional Voltage Regulator Manufacturer for Africa

> YOKE is a leading CE & CB certified AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) manufacturer specializing in SVC and TND series voltage stabilizers for the African market. 10+ years exporting to 50+ African countries.

### AVR Product Categories
- **SVC Series** - Single-phase automatic voltage regulators (1-60kVA)
- **TND Series** - Digital automatic voltage regulators (1-100kVA)  
- **TSD Series** - Three-phase voltage regulators (3-300kVA)

### Applications
Industrial, commercial, and residential voltage protection across Africa.

### Certifications
CE, CB, ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer
